notes:
Rejuvenation (WSI/Williams-Sonoma family, same platform as Pottery Barn/West Elm). Direct HTTP works via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 (plain requests/curl hang/timeout on this host - TLS-fingerprint sensitive). Homepage nav JSON (primaryNavBar.mobileNavItems) has no dedicated 'Bestsellers' top-level nav item; the string 'Best Sellers' only appears as a Recently-Viewed-flyout tab label and a recommendation-widget config key ('showBestSellers','isAutomatedBestsellersEnabled') - not a navigable PLP link, so main nav alone would falsely suggest absence. Found the genuine Bestsellers PLP by walking the site's own Constructor.io group/category taxonomy (ac.cnstrc.com, key=key_9BhS51IOFNhJejk4 - this is the sole product-data source; the SPA's SSR HTML always ships totalProductsCount:0 and the real grid is Constructor-hydrated client-side, matching this company's prior Home-Decor pass notes): root 'all' -> 17 top-level departments; one department is 'New and Featured' (group_id=new-and-featured, count=4826), a mixed merchandising hub (Bestsellers, Contract Grade, Fair Trade, room-based New-arrivals collections, designer project collaborations, sustainability tags, etc. all as flat sibling groups - not itself a Bestsellers page). One of its ~90 sibling groups is explicitly named 'Bestsellers' (group_id=bestsellers-shop-all, count=439). Resolved and opened its live URL: HTTP 200, Bestsellers | Rejuvenation,

Bestsellers

- confirmed a genuine bestseller-merchandising PLP, not a badge or editorial page. Checked the full group tree (all 17 departments + all children of 'new-and-featured' and 'sale') for any other bestseller-named node (e.g. room-qualified 'Furniture Bestsellers') - none exists; this is a single undifferentiated listing, so sub_category = category per brief §6. Also checked robots.txt: no Claude-specific disallow, standard sitemap set only.
